sentences.en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
sentences.zh: 你为什么对他这么苛刻？我无法理解。

sentences.en: I've been thinking that I may have been too critical.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得可能我对他的评价过于严厉了。

sentences.en: Ability to operate a computer is critical for this job.
sentences.zh: 对于这份工作来说，操作电脑的能力至关重要。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：crit（判断）+ical（…的）→做出判断的→评论的
